title: Rosemary Beach: Amos Cottage in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Amos Cottage in Rosemary Beach. Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and Complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Experience the best of beachside living in this beautifully designed home, perfectly situated just steps from the beach and adjacent to the Town Center’s shopping and dining and West Long Green Park. With thoughtful indoor and outdoor spaces, this home offers the ideal setting for a relaxing coastal getaway.

The detached first-floor bedroom provides privacy and comfort with a queen bed and en suite bathroom featuring a walk-in shower and single vanity. The bedroom connects to the main house through a covered and screened outdoor living room, creating a wonderful space to relax and enjoy the coastal breeze.

Inside the main house, the first floor features a well-appointed kitchen, comfortable living room, banquette dining with seating for six, and a convenient half bath. From the home, enjoy direct boardwalk access to the beach, making morning walks to the water or sunset strolls effortless.

Upstairs, you'll find two spacious king bedrooms, each with a private en suite bathroom. One features two vanities and a tub/shower combination, while the other offers a single vanity and walk-in shower. The second king suite also includes a private balcony overlooking the boardwalk below, providing a peaceful spot to enjoy your morning coffee or take in the activity of the neighborhood.

Outside, guests can take advantage of a gas grill and parking for two vehicles in the driveway. With the beach just steps away and the Town Center’s restaurants and shops right next door, you may find everything you need for the perfect beach vacation is within easy reach.

Whether you're gathering with family or enjoying a coastal escape with friends, this inviting home combines privacy, comfort, and an unbeatable location for a memorable stay.

7 NIGHT MINIMUM DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER
